name: Natural Presence Yoga Studio
when: Three classes a day, all levels
desc: Blair Hughes's studio on the edge of the village: vinyasa, power, yin/yang, hatha, meditation and breathwork, three slots a day. Opened January 2026, so it has already done a winter.

name: The Loft Ibiza — reformer pilates
when: Early morning to sundown · max 8 per class
desc: A reformer studio in the north with small classes and a clear ladder — Align, Power, Strength, Stretch — plus teacher training. Book a slot in their app; the schedule is live on their site.
status: Open all winter — confirm on Instagram

name: YOURS — reformer pilates
desc: Reformer classes with a live online schedule and booking. Details (village, winter hours) to come.

name: Hot Yoga Ibiza
desc: Ninety minutes, 26 postures, forty degrees — the one class that makes a January morning feel like August.

name: Ashtanga Yoga Ibiza
desc: Traditional ashtanga in the north, three evenings a week, with beginners' courses and workshops through the year.

name: Weekend vinyasa at Hostal La Torre
desc: Yoga on the cliff above the bay, then breakfast with the sea in front of you. Ran all last winter.

name: Amara Wellness Club
desc: Reformer pilates outdoors, meditation and sound sessions, with a heated pool, cold plunge, sauna and hammam at km 13 on the Sant Joan road. One of the few Ibiza studios on ClassPass.

name: Ecstatic Dance Ibiza
desc: Three hours of barefoot, no-talking, no-phones dancing, monthly, indoors in winter. The island's most loyal tribe.
status: Likely all winter — dates on Instagram

name: UMA — ASMR rituals
desc: New this summer, and like nothing else on the island: signature ASMR scratch rituals and body-roller sessions in a calm little studio on Carrer Velázquez, with a scent bar to mix your own oil. Book by WhatsApp.

name: Can Curreu spa
desc: The agroturismo's spa stays open when the big hotel spas have shut: thermal circuit, sauna, hammam, heated indoor pool and treatments, among the olive trees of the north.

name: Sirenis Vital Spa
desc: A proper day spa with winter hours: infrared sauna, wraps, massages, open late six days a week.

name: Can Lluc — sauna and treatments
desc: The agroturismo in the valley keeps its sauna and treatment rooms going all year; book ahead and make an afternoon of it.

name: Azurit Wellness
desc: A city day-spa on Ramon Muntaner with infrared and classic sauna and a long treatment list — the easy option on a grey afternoon in town.

name: Pablo Sahade — osteopath
desc: The osteopath half the island's expats go to, English and Spanish, home visits possible. +34 617 392 490.

name: Estar — Chinese medicine and Qi Gong
desc: Acupuncture and traditional Chinese medicine on the Es Canar road, with Qi Gong classes for the slow mornings.

name: New Year's Day dive at Ses Salines
desc: The island's hangover cure for over a decade: three waves of swimmers into the sea at Salines, then a shared lunch on the sand. Everyone is welcome; nobody stays in long.

name: La platja està oberta — free beach sports in town
desc: The town hall keeps its two beaches 'open' into December with free kayaks, paddleboards and beach sports on weekend mornings. Confirm this year's dates with the Ajuntament.

name: The Soul Hub — breathwork and ice bath
desc: Guided breathwork into an ice bath. Summer sessions were on a hotel rooftop; winter venue announced per date — write to hello@thesoulhub.com.

name: Sunday sound bath and gentle yoga at Casa Sukha
desc: Lisanne van den Heuvel's Sunday morning: gentle yoga, then an hour under the bowls.

name: Yin yoga with singing bowls at Can Tao
desc: A slow Thursday morning class with singing bowls, listed through the autumn.
